run_digit_find: run digit.find() to discover and list all connected DIGIT force sensor devices
create_digit_connection: create a Digit instance with a serial number and friendly name then call connect
run_digit_info: run digit.info() to print device information for a connected DIGIT sensor
run_digit_set_intensity: run digit.set_intensity() to change the LED illumination level on a DIGIT sensor
run_digit_get_frame: run digit.get_frame() to grab a single image frame from a connected DIGIT sensor
